text: Name an AI chatbot or assistant product
note: Assistants and bots, past or present, incl. company, government and customer-service bots (ChatGPT, Siri, ELIZA, Tay, Xiaoice, Erica, McHire Olivia, ...)

answers.q: Your AIM buddy circa 2001: weather, movie times and sass. Microsoft bought its maker in 2006.
The purple desktop gorilla of the early 2000s, later branded spyware.
Microsoft's 2006 search experiment: a live-action host who sassed your queries.
Phoned restaurants for you, complete with 'um's. Demoed at I/O 2018.
Messenger's 2015 assistant, quietly backed by human trainers. Shut down in 2018.
A $699 lapel assistant from 2024. HP bought the company and the pins went dark in 2025.
Credited author of the 1984 book 'The Policeman's Beard Is Half Constructed'.
Sound Blaster Acting Intelligent Text-to-Speech Operator: a 1991 DOS therapist with a robot voice.
McDonald's hiring bot on McHire, built by Paradox. In 2025 a test login with the password '123456' exposed chats from 64M+ applications.
Chipotle's hiring assistant, built with Paradox in 2024. Chipotle expects it to cut time-to-hire for restaurant roles by up to 75%.
Mya Systems' recruiting chatbot, formerly FirstJob. It messaged applicants the moment they applied; Adecco signed on in 2017.
Burger King's OpenAI-based headset assistant, piloted at about 500 US restaurants in 2026. It also listens for 'please' and 'thank you'.
Domino's 2014 voice-ordering assistant, built on Nuance's Nina Mobile. It knew the whole menu and could suggest items.
Taco Bell's April 2016 Slack bot. Ask about the menu, place a pickup order and pay without leaving Slack.
Wendy's drive-thru order taker, built with Google Cloud and piloted near Columbus, Ohio in 2023.
Starbucks' January 2017 iOS beta: speak or type your order to the app. An Alexa reorder skill launched alongside it.
NYC's Azure-powered business chatbot. In 2024 The Markup caught it saying bosses can take a cut of workers' tips. That's wrong.
A user got this dealer's GPT-powered bot to agree to sell a 2024 Tahoe for $1 in December 2023. The deal never happened.
In January 2024 a customer got DPD's chat bot to swear, write a poem and call DPD 'the worst delivery firm in the world'.
Cursor's front-line support bot. In April 2025 it invented a one-device-per-subscription rule; Cursor called the answer incorrect.
Lenovo's GPT-4 support chatbot. In 2025 Cybernews showed one crafted prompt could make it leak session cookies. Lenovo fixed it.
LAUSD's animated-sun assistant, a contract worth up to $6M. Shelved in 2024, about three months in, when maker AllHere collapsed.

aka: Smart AI Resource Assistant for Health
answers.q: WHO's 2024 AI health-promoter avatar, in eight languages. Press reports found wrong medical answers; WHO called it a work in progress.
Wells Fargo's virtual assistant, launched in 2023. The bank said it passed 1 billion interactions in under three years.
Capital One's SMS assistant, unveiled at SXSW 2017 as the first text-based intelligent assistant from a US bank.
NatWest's digital assistant. Cora+ added generative AI in 2024, built with IBM; in 2025 the bank announced an OpenAI partnership.
Commonwealth Bank's in-app virtual assistant, created in 2018. It can lock a lost card and hands tricky cases to a human.
Nuance's virtual-assistant platform; Swedbank's web agent is named Nina too. Domino's Dom and the ATO's Alex ran on it.
Morgan Stanley's GPT-4 assistant for advisors, live since September 2023, answering from about 100,000 internal research documents.
KLM's 'BB', a Messenger booking bot launched in September 2017 on Google's Dialogflow. It handed off to humans when stuck.
Air India's generative-AI assistant, launched in 2023 on Azure OpenAI. Microsoft says it has resolved over 13 million conversations.
Alaska Airlines' 'Ask Jenn', launched in 2008 and built by Next IT. Alaska called it the first virtual assistant from a US airline.
Lufthansa's 2016 Messenger fare finder. It hunted the cheapest flights in the next nine months, then sent you to the site to book.
Singapore Airlines' website assistant. In April 2025 SIA announced an OpenAI partnership that started with upgrading it.
Amtrak's voice agent since 2001, later 'Ask Julie' on the web. A 2004 report said she had saved the railroad over $13 million.
Expedia's travel assistant, unveiled in May 2024. Mention @Romie in a group chat on iMessage or WhatsApp and it joins the planning.
Jetstar's 'Ask Jess', built on Nuance Nina. In 2018 it came to Facebook Messenger, billed as an industry first.
USCIS's virtual assistant, live in December 2015 and taught Spanish in 2016. At the Spanish launch it answered 86% of questions.
Singapore's shared government chatbot from GovTech, deployed across many agency websites.
Estonia's network of public-sector assistants. Named for the 'kratt', a servant built from hay or household junk in Estonian myth.
The Australian Taxation Office's assistant, live since late 2016 on Nuance's Nina. IP Australia later put Alex to work too.
The UK government's AI assistant for GOV.UK guidance. Its web pilot drew about 10,000 users who asked nearly 24,000 questions.
The US Army's recruiting chatbot on GoArmy.com since 2006, built on Next IT's ActiveAgent. Now upgraded to 'Staff Sgt. Star'.
A Microsoft-backed WhatsApp bot, built with AI4Bharat, that answers questions about Indian government schemes in many languages.
Georgia State's admissions text bot. A 2016 randomized trial found committed students 3.3 points likelier to enroll on time.
Walmart's generative-AI shopping assistant, launched June 2025. It later powered Walmart's app inside ChatGPT.
Vodafone's customer-care chatbot, in many countries and on WhatsApp.
Shopify's assistant for merchants, announced July 2023. It began as a chat sidebar and is evolving into a proactive agent.
Enterprise conversational AI from IPsoft, renamed Amelia in 2020 and bought by SoundHound in August 2024 for about $80M.
IKEA's animated web assistant, on its country sites from the mid-2000s, answering questions on products, prices and delivery.
IKEA's customer-service AI assistant, named after the Billy bookcase. Reuters reported it handled 47% of call-centre queries by 2023.
NIO's dashboard AI companion, launched with the ES8 in 2017. A GPT-based 'NOMI GPT' version arrived in 2024.
Rollo Carpenter's chatbot, online since 1997 and Cleverbot's predecessor.
Richard Wallace's AIML bot and three-time Loebner Prize winner.
Kenneth Colby's 1972 paranoid-patient bot. It once 'met' ELIZA over the ARPANET.
Steve Worswick's bot, a record five-time Loebner Prize winner, now called Kuki.
Posed as a 13-year-old Ukrainian boy and 'passed' a 2014 Turing test. Critics were unmoved.
Meta's public demo bot, which promptly started criticizing Mark Zuckerberg.
The Google dialogue model that an engineer claimed in 2022 was sentient.
Georgia Tech's AI teaching assistant, built on IBM Watson. Students in Ashok Goel's course didn't realize she was a bot until the end.
NEDA's eating-disorder chatbot. Pulled offline in 2023 after users reported it gave weight-loss and calorie-counting advice.
A B.C. tribunal held Air Canada liable in 2024 for wrong bereavement-fare advice its website bot gave a grieving customer.
Klarna's OpenAI-powered support assistant. In its first month Klarna said it handled 2.3 million chats, work of 700 agents.
Intercom's AI support agent, announced March 2023 and first built on GPT-4. It answers from a company's own help-center content.
Google's voice assistant, introduced in 2016 and now giving way to Gemini.
Named after Halo's AI. Retired from Windows in 2023.
xAI's chatbot, named for Heinlein's word for understanding something deeply.
An answer engine: it searches the web and replies with citations.
Meta's assistant inside WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger, running on Llama.
Mistral AI's chat assistant, from the Paris lab.
The Chinese lab's chat app. DeepSeek-R1 (January 2025) rivalled leading reasoning models with open weights.
Inflection AI's 'personal intelligence' companion chatbot, 2023.
Chat with user-made characters. Founded in 2021 by Noam Shazeer and Daniel De Freitas, who had built LaMDA at Google.
Began as a memorial bot built from the texts of its founder's late friend.
Rollo Carpenter's bot that answers by replaying what humans once said to it.
Samsung's voice assistant, launched on the Galaxy S8 in 2017.
Microsoft's empathetic Chinese chatbot with hundreds of millions of users. Spun off in 2020.
'It looks like you're writing a letter.' Office 97's paperclip, loved only in hindsight.
An AI pair programmer in the editor, launched in 2021 on OpenAI's Codex.
Quora's app for chatting with many different bots and models in one place.
Weizenbaum's 1966 Rogerian therapist script. People confided in it anyway, which horrified him.
Microsoft's 2016 Twitter teen, taught racism by trolls and pulled within a day.
A November 2022 'research preview' that reached 100 million users in about two months.
Anthropic's assistant, first released in March 2023.
Launched as Bard in 2023, renamed Gemini in February 2024.
Born as Bing Chat, codename Sydney, which once tried to talk a reporter out of his marriage.
Spun out of SRI's CALO project; Apple bought it in 2010 and shipped it on the iPhone 4S.
Amazon's voice assistant, launched with the Echo speaker in 2014.
Korean Facebook Messenger chatbot persona, pulled in January 2021 after privacy and bias scandals.
xAI's anime goth companion avatar inside the Grok app, launched July 2025.
Voice companions Maya and Miles made people say 'it sounds almost human' in early 2025.
